description:

Matter

  • Adds support for Chime, MeterIdentification and SoilMeasurement clusters.

Apps

  • Fixes an issue that could cause Homey to freeze when starting apps with an extreme amount of drivers and Flow cards.

description:
Z-Wave

  • Official Z-Wave certified implementation.

  • Updated Z-Wave chip firmware to version 7.21.6.

  • Added SmartStart support. Devices can be added by scanning a QR code or by entering the DSK.

  • Added support for controlling door locks and thermostat mode/setpoint from the default Z-Wave device.

  • Added S2 multicast security support.

  • S2 now grants all requested security keys (except S0) instead of only the highest.

  • S0 can be enabled from the advanced settings when pairing a default Z-Wave device. Disabled by default.

  • If security bootstrapping fails during pairing, the user is informed and the node will be removed.

  • Improved handling of multiple decryption attempts for multiple security keys.

  • Incoming messages with too low or no security level are now ignored.

  • Associations are now validated against the destination node's supported security and command classes.

  • Return routes are correctly assigned when adding associations.

  • When a node is removed from the network, corresponding associations on other nodes are also removed.

  • Association group names are now retrieved from the node and shown in the device settings screen when not defined by the app.

  • Battery devices are now correctly and faster put back to sleep when there is no more data for them.

  • When changing settings of a battery device, an estimation is given for when the device will wake up. The result is shown in the timeline.

  • When changing associations on battery devices, the result is shown in the timeline after the device wakes up.

  • If a device sends a Device Reset Locally notification, it is removed from Homey after verification.

  • Added Inclusion Controller support.

  • Improved Security S0 handling.

  • Improved Transport Service handling.

Developer Tools

  • Healing a Z-Wave node now also updates return routes for all association destinations.

  • Added 'Update Z-Wave Routes' feature that performs a neighbour discovery of all non-battery Z-Wave nodes and assigns new return routes when needed.

  • Added 'Identify Z-Wave Node' feature. The node will flash a light or make a sound.

  • Testing a Z-Wave node now sends a NOP command instead of BASIC GET.

  • The list of pending Z-Wave SmartStart inclusions is now shown and new entries can be added.

  • When the Z-Wave network is reset, a Device Reset Locally notification is sent to nodes in the Lifeline group.

Energy

We're excited to announce that the Energy tab has returned! Get realtime and historical insights into electricity, gas and water usage as well as solar generation. The new Energy feature in the Homey mobile app (v9.1.0) is now available for testing on both iOS and Android.

Give it a try and let us know what you think! For more information check the Knowledge base article on Homey Energy.

Core

  • Updates translations.

  • Fixes an issue where devices would lose connection in large Matter networks.

  • Fixes an issue that prevented adding a Zemismart switch.

Apps

  • Fixes an issue that could cause "add device" events not to be processed properly during a pair session.

  • Fixes an issue that could cause weather temperature and CPU temperature values to be logged with an incorrect unit.

  • Fixes an issue that in rare cases could cause Zigbee not to start properly.

  • Adds ieeeAddress property on ZigBeeNode instance (developer documentation).

Introducing Moods

With Moods, you can create and save your own lighting setups effortlessly.

In order to use Moods, Mobile App version 8.2.0 or higher is required. You can get this public beta via TestFlight (iOS) or the Google Play Store (Android) (learn more).

Note: there is an issue related to Zigbee that is present since v10.3.0. Some Zigbee end-devices may experience difficulties reconnecting to Homey Pro after a reboot or firmware update. Also, in some cases Zigbee might become unavailable due to this issue. We are working together with Silicon Labs to resolve this issue as soon as possible. A fix is currently being tested internally and will be released in a future firmware update. We understand the frustration this may cause and apologize for any inconvenience it may bring to your smart home experience.

  • Removes undefined notification groups that were created after a migration from Homey Pro (2016—2019).

Alarms

  • Fixes an issue that could cause repeating alarm related Flow cards to not trigger when the alarm was disabled while it ran the last time.

  • Excludes devices from Zone Activity while they are unavailable.

Bluetooth Low Energy

  • Improves BLE memory usage and performance.

433 MHz & IR

  • Increase max message length to support longer IR and 433 MHz commands.

Z-Wave

  • Updates Z-Wave firmware to reduce TRANSMIT_COMPLETE_FAIL errors.
  • Improves message retry mechanism.
  • Adds support for Command Class Meter V6.

Matter

  • Adds support for Matter window coverings.
  • Adds support for Matter buttons.

Setup

  • Fixes an issue where enabling setup twice in a row would fail.

description:
This release marks the end of the Homey Pro (Early 2023) Early Access period.

Although this is the first stable firmware release, our work is never done. We continue our effort to solve issues and complete new features such as:

  • Support for additional Matter device types (e.g. thermostats, window coverings, and more).
  • Matter over Thread (Matter over Wi-Fi is already supported).
  • Satellite Mode for Zigbee (Z-Wave, 433 MHz, and IR are already supported).
  • Port Forwarding.

Special thanks to everyone who has been with us during the Early Access period and provided a lot of valuable feedback. It has made, and still makes, a huge difference and got us to where we are now.

If you have feedback or experience any issues, please let us know through our regular support channels.
